tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Cool neutral paper.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Header, cards, tab-note, facts panel, footer, search results ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, node names. 15.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Lede, tab-note text, nav links, proof line, table headers. 7.1:1 on paper, 7.7:1 on paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Node counts, node meta, frontier names, footer, disclosure arrow. 4.6:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on paper-raised. Fails on code-bg (4.3:1): the source pairs it there in .card .example figcaption; kept exact.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: header bottom, cards, panels, table rows, search input. Decorative only (1.2:1 on paper); the search input border relies on it and misses the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button border, card hover border, section top rules, tree-shortcut divider. 1.5:1 on paper; misses 3:1 as a control border, kept exact.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the haspack dot, eyebrow text, primary and research buttons, tab-note left rule. 6.5:1 on paper, 5.9:1 on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill and border. A literal in .btn:hover, not a variable in the source.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent and accent-hover fills. 7.1:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tree node highlight, eyebrow ground, ::selection, journey-check ground, blockquote rule.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px (3px on summary). 8.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code, pre blocks, card examples, menu item hover, hop lines.

families.display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, ui-serif, serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Sans, not serif. Fluid: step-3.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section; facts-panel title uses this size. Fluid: step-1.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Uppercase label heading in ink-muted. Fluid: step-0.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Browse published references and the topic map that connects them.
styles.usage: One sentence under h1, ink-muted. clamp(19px, 2.2vw, 23px) from lx-polish.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Frontier names indicate work to investigate, not published references.

styles.name: tree-node
styles.usage: Concept names in the tree column (.tree-col).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Click a concept to read its facts here.
styles.usage: Tab-note, facts panel, nav, tables, footer. Fluid: step--1.

styles.name: node-count
styles.usage: Grey count beside a branch name, ink-faint.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header. Lowercase, always.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title: accent on accent-soft, radius-sm, 6px 12px padding.

styles.name: proof
styles.sample: 2389 published references · 312 topic entries · 5068 frontier names · 16 roots
styles.usage: Counts line between line rules, ink-muted, items joined by a middle dot.

styles.name: node-meta
styles.usage: Meta line in a node body or card, ink-faint.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on code-bg, radius-sm, 0.15em 0.4em padding.
